indicators.label: Simple moving average (SMA)
indicators.description: The average price of the last N bars. Smooths out noise; price above a rising average is a common definition of an uptrend.

params.label: Period
params.description: Number of bars in the average.

indicators.label: Exponential moving average (EMA)
indicators.description: Like the SMA, but recent bars count more, so it reacts faster to new moves.

params.label: Period
params.description: Number of bars in the average.

indicators.label: Relative Strength Index (RSI)
indicators.description: Momentum from 0 to 100 (Wilder). Readings below 30 are often called oversold, above 70 overbought — in strong trends it can stay there for a long time.

indicators.label: MACD
indicators.description: The difference between a fast and a slow EMA (the MACD line), a signal line (an EMA of the MACD line) and the histogram (line − signal). Used to judge momentum: the line crossing above the signal line suggests momentum is turning up.

outputs.label: MACD line
outputs.meaning: a MACD value (difference of two averages, around 0)

outputs.label: Signal line
outputs.meaning: a MACD value (difference of two averages, around 0)

outputs.label: Histogram
outputs.meaning: a MACD value (difference of two averages, around 0)

notes: The fast period must be smaller than the slow period.

indicators.label: Bollinger Bands
indicators.description: A moving average (middle band) with bands N standard deviations above and below. %B shows where the close sits: 0 = on the lower band, 1 = on the upper band.

params.label: Period
params.description: Number of bars in the average.

params.label: Standard deviations
params.description: Band distance from the middle, in standard deviations.

outputs.label: %B (position within the bands)
outputs.meaning: a band position (0 = lower band, 1 = upper band)

indicators.label: Average True Range (ATR)
indicators.description: How far price typically moves per bar (Wilder). A volatility measure, not a direction — mostly used to size stops and targets.

indicators.label: Highest of previous bars (Donchian high)
indicators.description: The highest price of the previous N bars, NOT counting the current bar — so 'close crosses above the highest high of 20 bars' is a breakout.

indicators.label: Lowest of previous bars (Donchian low)
indicators.description: The lowest price of the previous N bars, NOT counting the current bar.

indicators.label: Rate of change (ROC)
indicators.description: How much the close changed over N bars, in percent. Above 0 = higher than N bars ago.

operators.label: crosses above
operators.description: Was at or below the other value on the previous bar and is above it on this bar. With 'within the last N bars' the cross may have happened up to N bars ago.

operators.label: crosses below
operators.description: Was at or above the other value on the previous bar and is below it on this bar.

operators.label: is between
operators.description: Within an inclusive range (low ≤ value ≤ high).

groups.label: All of these must be true
At least one of these must be true

contract_notes.RISE_FALL: Rise/Fall contracts always run to expiry: exit conditions, stops and targets do not apply. The stake is the most you can lose.
contract_notes.MULTIPLIER: Exit conditions close the contract early. Stops and targets become money amounts unless the assignment sets its own.
contract_notes.SPOT: Paper only. Every trade has the stop below; exit conditions can close it earlier.
